title: Non-participating masonry walls.
officialText:
Masonry walls that are not part of the lateral-force-resisting system shall be
isolated from the structure so that the vertical and lateral forces are not imparted to these elements. Isolation joints and
connectors between these elements and the structure shall be designed to accommodate the design story drift.
SECTION BC 2107
ALLOWABLE STRESS DESIGN
